      Sold 194.18± Acres

      Dallas County

      194± Acre Cattle Farm With Quality Pasture, Lake, Extensive Improvements And Home In Conway Missouri

      7100 State Rd Y Conway, MO 65632

      Listing Gallery

      Listing Gallery

      Description

      The Henson Farm is located in the heart of cattle country in Conway. This exceptional 194± acre farm offers a great opportunity to own a highly productive, well-improved agricultural operation, built for immediate use. Nearly all of the acreage is in quality pasture with productive soils, making this property ideal for a no-outsourcing cattle operation with the ability to produce your own hay, support rotational grazing, and potentially grow silage or grain crops for feed production.

      Designed with efficiency and functionality in mind, this farm is set up to support livestock while offering the beauty and privacy of a premier rural estate. The farm features quality perimeter and cross fencing, waterers supplied by well water, a creek, a nice lake, and a well-developed grazing system that supports cattle production at scale. A gated entrance off Y Highway provides excellent access, and proximity to Interstate 44 creates convenience for operators hauling livestock and hay. The working improvements include a pipe corral system with water access and load-out facilities designed to streamline livestock handling. Multiple farm structures provide outstanding utility and storage capacity, including a large shop, open lean-to, large hay barns, equipment barns, garages, and additional support buildings ready for machinery, feed, and operational needs. Whether expanding an existing cattle business or establishing a self-sustaining farm operation, the infrastructure is already in place.

      One of the standout features of this property is its balance of production and beauty. A picturesque half-mile private driveway leads to a secluded homestead situated near the center of the farm, offering privacy and panoramic views across rolling pastureland. The home features three bedrooms, two bathrooms and a finished downstairs game room or office, offering flexibility for remote work, recreation, or additional living space. A large screened-in porch creates an ideal place to enjoy the peaceful setting and overlook the farm.

      Location is another major strength. The farm sits in an excellent agricultural corridor with quick access to multiple sale barns, nearby communities, and an easy drive to Springfield for supplies, services, and regional markets. Its proximity to the Conway exit makes it convenient while maintaining the privacy and setting that buyers seek in a premier farm. This is a true bring-your-livestock-to-closing property where the next owner can step in and begin operating immediately.

      Call the Utecht Land Team at 417-766-5595 today to schedule your private showing.
